new.program_name: Amazon Built Together: Modular Training Centers and free community college in data center communities
new.partner_org: Local community colleges (agreements with 26 colleges reported in the works; none named); construction partners (unnamed)
new.funding_status_detail: not disclosed for trades training specifically: Built Together is "more than $1 billion over five years" across education, job training, energy affordability, water and local projects with no breakdown; Amazon told GeekWire it expects "more than $100 million up front into community college endowments and roughly another $100 million into expanding its training centers" (approximate, not counted)
new.program_type_detail: not labelled an apprenticeship - free skilled-trades certification programs of 4 to 16 weeks at Modular Training Centers "with direct pathways to employment at Amazon and our construction partners", plus free community college certificates/associate degrees
new.workers_trained_detail: Goals, not counted: up to 100,000 learners prepared annually through training centers by end of 2028 (annual rate); 300,000+ students connected to free community college over five years (includes non-trades fields). Each MTC trains approximately 2,000-4,000 learners per year. Existing programs: over 10,000 learners and educators participating across 15 data center regions (programs not named; includes educators).
new.data_center_relevance_note: Modular Training Centers sit on or near Amazon data center sites and include simulated data halls, mechanical galleries and outside-plant yards (fiber vaults, utility poles, heavy machinery)
new.notes: 3 MTCs operating, 6 in development, 16 more planned (network of 25); no center or college named. Communities named as examples: St. Joseph County IN, Montgomery County MO, Loudoun County VA, Madison County MS, Morrow County OR - not listed as training-site states because no training location is tied to them. No union or apprenticeship involvement is mentioned. Related to but distinct from init-10/11/12 (existing AWS programs, not referenced on these pages). The $1B+ total is recorded in excluded_from_total.

source_urls.supports: Built Together announcement: $1B+ over five years in addition to existing activity; MTC details (4-16 week certifications, equipment, 3 operating/6 in development/16 planned); 100,000 learners annually by end of 2028; trades named; 10,000+ current learners and educators
Announcement dated October 2, 2026; 300,000+ students free community college goal; network of 25 modular training centers; eligible fields list
Amazon's approximate split: $100M+ community college endowments and ~$100M for training-center expansion; agreements with 26 colleges in the works
